title: 1 — Launch Pane
description: Graphite squircle holding a grid of agent tiles; one tile lifts clear of the grid and glows mint. Literal metaphor for a pane of background jobs with one launching.

title: 2 — Ignition Switch
description: Free-form, no plate. A vertical toggle in the ON position with a power-symbol knob. Boldest silhouette at tiny sizes; instantly reads as enable/disable.

title: 3 — Cut-Out Launch Pane
description: Indigo squircle with a launch arrow knocked out of a white pane so the gradient shows through. The most Apple-native option and the cleanest at 16 px.

title: 4 — Daemon Pulse
description: Free-form pane frame with a live heartbeat running straight through and past it. Says "watch what runs in the background"; most distinctive outline.

title: 5 — Pane Stack
description: Free-form 3D stack of tilted panes, front pane active with a green launch arrow. Richest and most premium, but the busiest at 16 px.
